svg.title: Two panels. In Kyle's market the price distributions with and without a cheat overlap almost completely. In a market with plenty of price-only investors and little noise, the two outcomes are thin lines 0.17 apart and easy to tell apart.

fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 10,5; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke: var(--fig-blue, #3e6d93); stroke-width: 2
fill: none; stroke: var(--text-muted, #6a6358); stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: the cheat shifts the price by 0.21;
